title: [review] forwarding_buffer.py:229: Reentrancy bug in evictio
description: The on_drop callback is invoked at line 229-235 BEFORE the new entry is added at lines 239-240. If on_drop re-enters try_buffer with a different source_iid, that call sees len(self._buffer) < max_sources (since the evicted source was already removed) and adds a new source. Then the original call continues and adds its entry, resulting in max_sources + 1 tracked sources. Fix: defer on_drop calls until after state is fully updated, or guard against reentrant calls.
